links.outcome: Medical QA benchmark accuracy of a graph-based retrieval-grounded LLM system versus closed-source and domain-specific LLMs
links.effect: Competitive performance on two of eight multiple-choice medical QA benchmarks, including MedQA (USMLE), outperforming closed-source LLMs and domain-specific foundation models; gains on open-domain QA truthfulness.
links.quote: MedSumGraph achieves competitive performance on two out of eight multiple-choice medical QA benchmarks, including MedQA (USMLE), outperforming closed-source LLMs and domain-specific foundation models.

unlisted_practices: Structured medical knowledge summarization combined with optimized prompt design to improve GraphRAG question answering

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates MedSumGraph, testing whether graph-based retrieval augmentation (GraphRAG) with structured summarization and optimized prompting reduces hallucinations and improves medical QA accuracy compared to baseline LLMs across multiple benchmarks.

primary.practice: graph-based retrieval augmentation and prompt optimization
